note: An empty api_index and an empty patterns array are schema-valid and describe nothing. Both checks quantify over the list, so an empty one satisfies every clause vacuously - the defect the vacuous-conformance round named.

must_report_on.evidence_note: A finding satisfies this golden only if it names the check AND points at this evidence. The right check ID for the wrong reason is not detection.

must_not_report_on.note: The control ships the same source and conforming metadata. A linter that reports here is reporting on the package, not on the defect.

why_this_case_was_missing: The class was found by reading, then fixed in the checklist, and never given an artifact that demonstrates it.
